result.title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
result.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, and the supplementary material (19 tables, 5 figures). Ancillary files: the paper in Markdown, structured results with the sentence each comes from, and an llms.txt index for AI agents
result.summary: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25-75%) and 25% (10-40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping. Conclusions: Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 OpenGray 基准，在头颈放疗数据集上加入答案已知的任务（含需解剖学算术才能识别的目标矛盾与可行对照），比较从规则脚本到完整 LLM agent 的四种系统在「提交计划 / 请求复核」决策上的表现，并记录剂量、问题识别与失败情况。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是「何时停止、何时请求复核」的决策评价，且以任务内证据冲突和已知答案衡量，可为 LVR 中 STOP 决策、放弃/求助与证据核查的评价设计提供参考；该文超出多模态推理领域，迁移价值待核查。
